verdict.rationale: Baseten documents a dedicated streaming page that returns model output token by token as it is generated (baseten-docs-8). Its inference overview states explicitly that streaming sends tokens over server-sent events for UIs where partial output beats a blank wait (baseten-docs-26). The OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions endpoint supports familiar SDK clients (baseten-docs-21). Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of streaming latency or behavior.
